methods.label: Calculate each final answer
methods.explanation:
Follow each person's instructions in the stated order. Parentheses group the work done before doubling:
\[
\begin{aligned}
\text{José: }&(10-1)\times2+2=18+2=20,\\
\text{Thuy: }&10\times2-1+2=20-1+2=21,\\
\text{Kareem: }&(10-1+2)\times2=11\times2=22.
\end{aligned}
\]
Since \(22\) is the largest result, Kareem gets the largest final answer, choice C.
